definitionZh: 内置区块 CSS 短手属性定义了元素的逻辑区块始末抵消,该区块根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将其映射为物理抵消. 它与上下或左右属性相对应,取决于为写法模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。
sourceDefinition: The inset-block CSS shorthand property defines the logical block start and end offsets of an element, which maps to physical offsets depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the top and bottom, or right and left properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
